get.summary: Get a cluster by name
Get kubeconfig for a cluster
get.description:
Returns a kubeconfig for a cluster in the requested project.

`type=ephemeral` mints a short-lived cluster-admin kubeconfig for
automated bootstrap. The request is authorized in the project named in
the path. The caller must be allowed to read the cluster and must also
have the project-scoped `clusters` special action
`ephemeral_kube_admin` on that cluster. Built-in project admins have
this special action; project members and viewers do not. Organization
owners/admins inherit project-admin access. Service accounts are
evaluated through the same RBAC model, so a Terraform or CI service
account can call this endpoint only if one of its org/project bindings
grants the same effective permission. The organization
`adminKubeconfigEnabled` policy controls only static long-lived admin
kubeconfigs; it does not disable `type=ephemeral`.

For `type=ephemeral`, Compute creates a temporary cluster-admin
ServiceAccount in the target cluster, with a name like
`kube-system/compute-ephemeral-admin-<request-id>`, and returns a
kubeconfig with a short-lived token. The token expires automatically at
the returned expiry time. Mistral attempts to delete the temporary
ServiceAccount after expiry. That cleanup is best effort and can fail,
so the ServiceAccount may remain until a later cleanup or manual
removal; cleanup failure does not extend the returned token's lifetime.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Type of kubeconfig: admin (static long-lived credentials), oidc (kubelogin exec plugin), or ephemeral (short-lived cluster-admin ServiceAccount token, for automated bootstrap).

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Requested token TTL in seconds for type=ephemeral (clamped to 60..86400). Ignored for other types. The effective expiry may be further capped by Compute or the tenant API server; the effective value is returned as expiresAt in the response.

403.description: Insufficient permissions. Ephemeral admin kubeconfig requires the project-scoped `clusters` special action `ephemeral_kube_admin`.

409.description: Public API server access is enabled but its endpoint is not ready yet

ProjectPath.name: project
ProjectPath.description: Project slug. Use 'default' for the auto-created default project.

BearerAuth.description: API key from a service account. Create one in [Settings → Service Accounts](/settings/service-accounts).

ServiceAccountJWT.description: Short-lived JWT (TTL 1h) obtained via the OAuth2 client_credentials grant. Issued by the platform OAuth2 proxy from a service account's client_id/client_secret. The token carries `org_id`, `sa_name`, and `role` claims.

slug.description: Immutable project identifier used in URLs and namespaces.

createdBy.description:
User id of the person who created the project. Null for
system-created projects (the default project). Used by the
UI to flag the immutable creator-admin grant on the
project members page.

slug.description:
Lowercase DNS-1123 label. Starts with a letter, ends with
[a-z0-9], single hyphens only, 2-19 chars. Cannot be one of:
default, org, admin, api.

ProjectUpdate.description: Patch the mutable fields of a project. All fields optional.

role.description: Role within the project. Free-form to allow custom roles.

inheritedFromOrgRole.description:
True for org owners/admins who inherit project admin without
an explicit ProjectMembership row. Such entries cannot be
removed via the project members endpoint; manage the org role
instead.

isCreator.description:
True if this member is the project's creator. The server
refuses to change or remove the creator's role; the UI
should mirror that by disabling the role select and the
remove button for this row.

ProjectOAuth2Client.description:
OAuth2 client owned by a project. Used by external services
(per-project Grafana) to authenticate users through the compute
API's authorization_code grant. The client_secret is never
returned by this schema. Use the rotate endpoint to retrieve a
usable secret.

clientId.description: Stable identifier used by external services as their `client_id` in OAuth2.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful token issuance using this client. Null when never used.

ProjectOAuth2ClientCredentials.description:
Plaintext credentials returned ONCE by the rotate endpoint. The
secret is unrecoverable afterwards. Store it immediately.

slug.description: Virtual tenant name used to build service URLs (e.g. Grafana).

ssoConfigured.description: Whether the organization has SSO providers configured in Ory.

ssoDomains.description: The email domains configured for SSO routing.

allowSelfRegistration.description:
When true and the organization has SSO configured, users authenticating via
SSO who are not yet members are auto-enrolled with selfRegistrationDefaultRole.
Automatically forced to false when the organization no longer has any SSO connection.

selfRegistrationDefaultRole.description: Role assigned to self-registered SSO members. Defaults to "member".

adminKubeconfigEnabled.description:
When false, static long-lived admin kubeconfig retrieval is blocked
for the entire organization even if a caller's role includes the
admin_kubeconfig action. Short-lived ephemeral admin kubeconfigs
remain available to callers with the separate ephemeral_kube_admin
action. OIDC kubeconfig retrieval remains available to authorized
callers. Only organization owners can change this setting.

autoKubeAccessDurationMinutes.description:
Maximum lifetime, in minutes, for kube-access requests that are
automatically approved by the organization's auto-allow policy.
The platform maximum still applies. Auto-approved requests remain
attached to and logged in the backing support ticket.

allowSelfRegistration.description: Toggle SSO self-registration. Requires SSO to be configured (rejected with 400 otherwise).

selfRegistrationDefaultRole.description: Role to assign to self-registered SSO members.

adminKubeconfigEnabled.description:
Org-level policy toggle for static long-lived admin kubeconfig
retrieval. Defaults to true. Does not disable short-lived ephemeral
admin kubeconfigs. Only organization owners can change this setting.

autoKubeAccessDurationMinutes.description:
Maximum lifetime, in minutes, for auto-approved kube-access
requests. The platform maximum still applies. Only organization
owners and admins can change this setting.

MetricsExportAuth.description:
Auth material for the destination endpoint. Secret values are accepted
on create/update/test but are never returned by the API.

mtlsCaCertificate.description: Optional PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the destination server.

mtlsClientCertificate.description: PEM-encoded client certificate chain for mutual TLS.

mtlsClientPrivateKey.description: PEM-encoded private key for the mutual TLS client certificate.

endpointUrl.description:
OTLP HTTP endpoint URL (for example https://host/otlp) or OTLP
gRPC endpoint (host:port, https://host:port, or http://host:port).

key.description: Stable category key used in selectedDeviceCategories.

role.description: Role name (built-in or custom; see GET /v1/roles).

recoveryLink.description: Recovery page URL for password-auth users to set their password. Only returned on invite.

recoveryCode.description: One-time recovery code for password-auth users to enter on the recovery page. Only returned on invite.

recoveryExpiresAt.description: Expiry timestamp for the recovery code. Only returned on invite.

email.description: Email address of the user to invite. Creates an Ory identity if one doesn't exist.

role.description: Role name (built-in or custom; see GET /v1/roles).
Role name (built-in or custom; see GET /v1/roles).

PublicAccessConfig.description: Public endpoint configuration. The presence of apiServer enables public Kubernetes API access.

PublicAPIServerAccessConfig.description: Public Kubernetes API server access configuration.

allowedCIDRs.description: IPv4 and IPv6 CIDR ranges allowed to reach the public API server. When omitted, access defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0. An explicitly empty list is invalid.

hpcOperator.description: Mistral HPC Operator for managed Slurm clusters with pre-configured storage, per-user login nodes, and active health checks

kubeVersion.description: Kubernetes version for the nodes. Defaults to the parent cluster's control-plane version when omitted. Must not exceed the control-plane version (kubelet must be no newer than the API server).

HostSelector.description:
Selects BareMetalHost resources by labels. At least one of
`matchLabels` or `matchExpressions` must be set; the requirements are
ANDed.

matchLabels.description: Map of {key,value} pairs that must match exactly.

matchExpressions.description: List of label selector requirements, ANDed together.

LabelSelectorRequirement.description:
A label selector requirement matching a key against a set of values.

Cross-field constraints (enforced server-side, returns 400 on violation):
  - `In` and `NotIn` require `values` to contain at least one entry.
  - `Exists` and `DoesNotExist` require `values` to be omitted or empty.

key.description: Label key the selector applies to.

operator.description: Operator relating the key to the values.

values.description: Required for `In`/`NotIn`; must be empty for `Exists`/`DoesNotExist`.

expiresAt.description: For type=ephemeral, the effective expiry enforced by Compute for the embedded credential (may differ from the requested ttl). Absent for admin/oidc kubeconfigs.

projectSlug.description: Set for events scoped to a project; null for org-scoped events.

changes.description: For update operations, contains changed fields with old and new values.

nextCursor.description: Timestamp cursor for the next page. Null if no more results.

maxClusters.description: Maximum number of clusters. -1 means unlimited.

currentClusters.description: Current number of clusters in the region.

maxStorageGb.description: Maximum storage in GB. -1 means unlimited.

currentStorageGb.description: Current storage usage in GB across all clusters in the region.

bindings.description:
Role grants attached to this service account. Org-scope
bindings apply to org-wide endpoints; project-scope bindings
apply inside their project. The SA's effective permissions
are the union of every binding (categories are disjoint
across scopes, so there's nothing to reconcile).

platformManaged.description: True for service accounts created and managed by the platform (e.g. NVSentinel). These cannot be deleted via the API.

ServiceAccountBinding.description:
One role grant on a service account. `scope: org` bindings have
no `project`; `scope: project` bindings name a project slug.

role.description: Role name (built-in or custom; see GET /v1/roles).

project.description: Project slug; required when scope is `project`, omitted for `org`.

bindings.description:
Initial role grants. At least one binding is required:
an SA without bindings can authenticate but cannot do
anything, which is a configuration smell.

When set, replaces the SA's binding set atomically. Omit
to leave bindings untouched.

ProjectServiceAccountCreate.description:
Body for createProjectServiceAccount. The project comes from the
URL; the SA is created with a single project-scope binding to
that project.

ProjectServiceAccountUpdate.description:
Body for updateProjectServiceAccount. Description and the SA's
role within this project can be changed; the binding's scope
and project are immutable from this endpoint.

KMSKey.description:
A key managed in the external Key Management System. The
cryptographic material never leaves the KMS; this resource is
metadata plus a reference (kmsKeyId) to the underlying object.

scope.description: org-scoped keys apply org-wide; project-scoped keys belong to one project.

project.description: Project slug; set only when scope is `project`.

managedBy.description: platform-managed keys are provisioned by the platform and are immutable via the API.

origin.description: generated = created in the KMS; imported = customer-provided (BYOK).

kmsKeyId.description: The KMS UniqueIdentifier of the underlying key material.

KMSKeyCreate.description:
Body for createKMSKey / createProjectKMSKey. Scope is implied by the
route (org-level vs project-level).

keyMaterial.description:
Base64-encoded raw key material for BYOK import. When provided,
the KMS imports this material instead of generating new material.
Only valid for symmetric algorithms. Never stored by the server.

KMSKeyUpdate.description: Partial update. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

prefix.description: First 8 characters of the key for identification.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful authentication using this key. Null means it has never been used.

expired.description: True when expiresAt is in the past.

expiresSoon.description: True when the key expires within the next 14 days.

unused.description: True when the key has never been successfully used.

name.description: Optional name for the replacement key. Defaults to the old key name with "-rotated".

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration for the replacement key. Defaults to the old key's expiration.

APIKeyCreated.description: The full API key value is only returned once at creation time.

key.description: Full API key (msk_...). Only returned at creation time.

ServiceAccountOAuth2ClientPurpose.description:
Token audience for this OAuth2 client. "api" tokens can call the normal API.
"node_events" tokens can only authenticate the node-events webhook.

platformManaged.description: True for OAuth2 clients created and managed by the platform (e.g. NVSentinel). These cannot be deleted via the API.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful client_credentials token exchange. Null means it has never been used.

expired.description: True when expiresAt is in the past.

expiresSoon.description: True when the client expires within the next 14 days.

unused.description: True when the client has never successfully exchanged credentials for a token.

ServiceAccountOAuth2ClientCreated.description: OAuth2 client credentials for client_credentials flow. The client secret is only shown once.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret. Only returned at creation time.

tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint for client_credentials flow.

OIDCClaimRule.description:
One all-match rule applied to the third-party OIDC token claims.
`equals` and `glob` use `value`; `one_of` uses `values`.
Claim paths use dot notation for nested objects.

clientId.description: Public routing identifier for token exchange. Not a secret.

tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint for token exchange.

lastUsedAt.description: Last successful token exchange. Null means this trust has never been used.

unused.description: True when the trust has never successfully exchanged a token.

count.description: Number of times this event has been observed.

lastSeenAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent occurrence (null if count is 1).

nextCursor.description: Timestamp cursor for the next page. Null if no more results.

TicketNodeMoveRequest.description:
Structured payload describing a request to move capacity between two
projects in the same org. Required when a ticket's category is
"node_move". Platform admins review and execute the move via the
existing admin capacity tools; the ticket is the request channel.

region.description: Region the affected capacity lives in.

fromProject.description: Project slug the capacity currently belongs to.

toProject.description: Project slug the capacity should move to. Must differ from fromProject.

items.description:
Identifiers of the capacity to move. For scope=node, these are
BMH names. For scope=rack or pod, these are rack/pod names.

TicketAffectedResource.description: Optional reference to a compute resource the ticket is about.

region.description: Region the resource lives in (omit for region-kind tickets).

createdBy.description: Email of the org member who opened the ticket.

unread.description: True when at least one reply was added after the org last marked the ticket as seen.

private.description: When true, the ticket is visible only to the member who opened it (still org-scoped server-side).

nodeMove.description: Present when category is "node_move". Describes the requested capacity move.

replies.description: Conversation thread, ordered oldest first. Populated by getTicket; may be empty in list responses.

private.description: When true, the ticket will only be visible to the member who opens it.

nodeMove.description: Required when category is "node_move". Describes the requested capacity move.

AccessRequestLevel.description:
Requested Kubernetes access level. Maps to a scoped group injected at
token-review time (view -> read-only, edit -> read/write, admin ->
cluster-admin). Read-only by default.

AutoKubeAccessLevel.description:
Organization policy for automatically approving platform-admin kube
access requests. "disabled" requires manual approval, "read_only"
auto-approves view requests only, and "all" auto-approves view, edit,
and admin requests. Auto-approved requests are still attached to and
logged in the backing support ticket.

AccessRequest.description:
A platform support agent's request for temporary kube access to a
cluster in this organization. Enforcement is at project granularity:
an active grant lets the agent reach any cluster in the named project.

justification.description: Free-text reason the agent gave, shown to the approver.

durationMinutes.description: Requested (and, once approved, granted) grant lifetime in minutes.

agentEmail.description: Email of the platform support agent who opened the request.

ticketId.description: Backing support ticket; the conversation lives there.

expiresAt.description: Hard expiry of the grant. Access stops at this time.

durationMinutes.description:
Optional override for the grant lifetime. Clamped to the platform
maximum. When omitted, the agent's requested duration is used.

reason.description: Optional reason shown to the agent and posted to the ticket.

linearResolveStateId.description: Linear workflow state ID to transition issues to on resolution.

linearLabelIds.description: Linear label IDs to apply to created issues.

lastErrorAt.description: Timestamp of the last delivery error.

NotificationChannelFilters.description: Optional routing filters. If empty or omitted, the channel receives all events.

SlackChannelConfig.description: Slack configuration (bot token is never returned).

LinearChannelConfig.description: Linear configuration (API key is never returned).

secret.description: Optional Bearer token sent in the Authorization header.
Optional Bearer token. Leave empty to keep current.

url.description: Full URL for the SSO onboarding portal.

domains.description: Email domains to route to SSO (e.g. ["example.com", "example.org"]).

migratedIdentities.description: Number of existing member identities linked to SSO.

RoleScope.description:
Whether the role grants permissions on org-wide resources
(members, SSO, custom roles, audit logs, notifications) or on
project-scoped resources (clusters, nodes, project members).
Built-in roles exist in both scopes; custom roles declare their
scope at creation and cannot change it.

builtin.description: Built-in roles are not editable or deletable.

permissions.description:
Per-category permission map. Keys are category names from
`GET /v1/roles/categories`. Values describe the level granted,
optional special action toggles, and an optional resource-id
allowlist.

name.description: Stable, unique slug. Reserved names (owner/admin/member/viewer) are rejected.

level.description:
Inherited permission level for the category. delete > update > create > read.
Empty string (or omitted) means no level access.

specials.description: Special action toggles (e.g. admin_kubeconfig, share, reboot, import, test).

scope.description: "all" (default) grants the level/specials on every resource in the category; "restricted" limits to the listed ids.

name.description: Optional display name for the principal being simulated.

roleName.description: Existing role to simulate. Use this or permissions.

permissions.description: Inline permission map to simulate before creating/updating a role. Use this or roleName.

subject.description: Optional display-only subject echoed in the response. The simulator does not look up memberships or service accounts.

checks.description: Optional concrete checks to evaluate against the simulated role.

resourceIds.description: Specific resource ids allowed, or ["*"] for all.
Specific resource ids the caller is allowed on, or ["*"] for all.

checkName.description: Identifier for the type of check that produced this event.

nodeName.description: Kubernetes node name. Must belong to the JWT's organization.

isHealthy.description: True for resolution events; clears matching open events without inserting.
